attrs.name: the trade road
attrs.note: A1 §5.1: north-west off the ford, around the mire's head. canon.md §4 does not state this leg; A1 derives 2 days.
attrs.amendedPending: AMENDED-PENDING (I-095): note above cites the pre-F-045 day-count derivation (A1's '2 days') — this leg is now 11 km / 1 h on the rescaled world.

attrs.name: the coastal spur
attrs.note: canon.md §4: Gildmark is about 3 days from both war towns by a coastal spur. Already past the mire when it starts.
attrs.amendedPending: AMENDED-PENDING (I-095): note above cites the pre-F-045 day-count claim ('about 3 days') — this leg is now 17 km / 1.5 h on the rescaled world.

attrs.name: the east-rim track
attrs.note: A1 §5.1: the east-rim track joins the spur near Emberdown; the 3-day count is for the whole Norhollow → Gildmark run (~95 km), of which this leg is the eastern ~43 km.
attrs.amendedPending: AMENDED-PENDING (I-095): note above cites pre-F-045 absolute km (~95 km whole run, ~43 km eastern leg) and the day-count derivation — this leg is now 8.6 km / 1 h (throughRoute to Gildmark: 19 km / 1.5 h) on the rescaled world.

attrs.name: the crossing of the flat
attrs.note: canon.md §4: sister towns roughly a day's ride apart; wartime crossing is under a day, which is exactly why the front is so lethal.
attrs.amendedPending: AMENDED-PENDING (I-095): note above cites the pre-F-045 day-count claim ('a day's ride') — this leg is now 6 km / 0.5 h on the rescaled world.

attrs.name: the river road
attrs.note: canon.md §4: Rooktide sits inland, south of Millcross, about 2 days. Follows the river's south bank.
attrs.amendedPending: AMENDED-PENDING (I-095): note above cites the pre-F-045 day-count claim ('about 2 days') — this leg is now 12 km / 1 h on the rescaled world.

attrs.name: the Cindervast approach
attrs.note: A1 §7.1: drawn as a dashed line because it is not maintained. A1 §2: the only pass north runs behind Cindervast's shoulder. No leg day-count is stated; the walking table carries the end-to-end figure instead.

attrs.label: the trade wind · once a year
attrs.note: One voyage, not two: the once-a-year trade wind, charted end to end at last — the merchantmen that reach Gildmark on the trade wind are the ones that tied up at Tallowquay first.

attrs.label: a foreign coastal lane
attrs.note: A foreign-to-foreign coastal lane; no Gildmark keel has run it. Mariners say it runs the year round — no log from Gildmark confirms the claim.
